verdict.rationale: Docs describe a full consent chain: passkey-based step-up authentication is set up at enrollment, the agent must have the user authenticate a Payment Instruction via Passkey before spending, mandates carry a decline threshold, consumerPrompt text, and expiry, and VisaNet enforces that authorization matches the amount/merchant tied to that authenticated instruction — with revocation of a purchase intent also documented. Trusted Agent Protocol adds cryptographic signature verification (RFC 9421) binding the agent to the specific action/domain, and community commentary raises forward-looking concerns about agent-identity standards rather than contradicting that consent/mandate mechanics work as documented. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation the passkey-and-mandate flow works end-to-end in production, and the product itself carries a maturity caveat that it is still 'in the process of development and deployment'.
